The card asked for the mountain 'whose first ascent in 1938' the Nazis exploited, but the Eiger's summit was first climbed on 11 Aug 1858 (Barrington, Almer, Bohren); 1938 was the first ascent of its NORTH FACE (Heckmair, Vörg, Harrer, Kasparek), which the regime used for propaganda (HLS). Reworded to the north face; the card's text is kept in cardText.
